learning_outcomes.text: Know methods and software in the field of data analysis, planning, modeling, and simulation.
Be able to apply methods and software in the field of data analysis, planning, modeling, and simulation in the energy industry.
Be able to decompose complex energy economic problems into sub-models and solve them independently with software support.

syllabus_topics: Model development in the named software environments and programming languages
Determination of area availability for Renewable Energies with land use and area use models
Model-based calculation of Renewable Energy generation (e.g. wind, PV, hydropower) implementation of knowledge in practical exercises (electricity trading simulation game)
assessment_rules: To receive credit points, the module exam must be passed. The grade's weight for the final grade is determined by the credit points.
bibliography: Current literature (including manuals) will be provided in the lectures
